description: REQUIRES prior hometax__session__login call with same account_link_id. Search the list of trade partners the customer has registered for management. For an authenticated call, generate and save request_idempotency_key before the first request. Reuse it with the same arguments only to recover that request after a lost response; use a new key for a new execution. Without it, calling again remains a new request. This optional key is not available to anonymous taste calls. Keep any provider-specific idempotency_key unchanged; it is a different field. 호출마다 토큰 1소진 요청 처리 시 XBOSS 작업을 생성하고 처리 결과를 저장합니다. 기관 원본의 조회 여부와 별개로 이 호출은 순수 읽기 전용이 아닙니다. 기관 데이터 변경은 도구별 실행 내용과 기존 확인 절차를 따릅니다.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

request_idempotency_key.description: Optional same-request recovery key for authenticated calls; see the tool description.

srt_cl_cd.description: Sort column (정렬 기준): '1'=name(거래처명), '2'=business number, '3'=representative, '4'=registration date. Default '1'.

txpr_dscm_no.description: Filter by trade partner business number (거래처 등록번호, hyphens ok). Optional.

txpr_nm.description: Filter by trade partner name (거래처명). Optional.
